note: Open seat: Sen. Jeanne Shaheen (D) not seeking re-election. Also on ballot: Edmond Laplante (Constitution).

cands.name: Chris Pappas
cands.desc: U.S. Representative for NH's 1st District since 2019; won the Sept 8 Democratic primary; has tied Sununu to President Trump.

cands.name: John E. Sununu
cands.desc: Former U.S. Senator (2003–2009); pitches 'the New Hampshire way' of open debate and problem-solving; endorsed by President Donald Trump; won the primary 69.6% over Scott Brown.

note: Incumbent Kelly Ayotte (R) seeks a second two-year term. Also on ballot: Stephen Villee (L).

cands.name: Kelly Ayotte
cands.desc: Governor since 2025, former U.S. Senator and attorney general; pledges to keep NH on the 'Sununu path' and has broken with her party on some issues (vetoed HB 148).

cands.name: Cinde Warmington
cands.desc: Former Executive Councilor and health care attorney; campaigning on the affordability crisis and standing up to President Trump.
